p: ignorance against any of the commandments: That is, of negligence or ignorance, especially in the ceremonial law: for otherwise the punishment for a crime is determined according to the transgression, Nu 15:22.
the priest that is anointed do: Meaning, the high priest.
kill the bullock before the LORD: By this confessing that he deserved the same punishment which the beast suffered.
sanctuary: Which was between the holiest of holies and the sanctuary.
tabernacle of the congregation: Which was in the court: meaning by the tabernacle the sanctuary: and in the end of this verse it is taken for the court.
whole congregation of Israel sin through: The multitude does not excuse the sin, but if all have sinned, they must all be punished.
elders of the congregation shall lay: For all the people could not lay on their hands: therefore it was sufficient that the elders of the people did it in the name of all the congregation.
in the place where they kill: That is, the priest shall kill it; for it was not lawful for any out of that office to kill the beast.
an atonement for him as concerning: In which he represented Jesus Christ.
And he shall lay his hand: Read Le 4:24.
hand upon the head of the: Meaning that the punishment of his sin should be laid on the beast, or, that he had received all things from God, and offered this willingly.
according to the offerings made by: Or, besides the burnt offerings, which were daily offered to the Lord.
